user.title: FutDial
user.description: Find out on which Movistar Plus+ channel and dial number each match is broadcast.

data.dias: Days of TV guide to fetch

data_description.equipos: Pick from the list or type another one. Three sensors are created per team: channel ('M+ LALIGA - 54'), dial (54) and match date and time.
data_description.intervalo: When refreshing every few days, enough days are downloaded to cover until the next refresh.
data_description.incluir_repeticiones: Otherwise only live or first-run broadcasts are shown.
data_description.todos_los_canales: Downloads the full guide (about 11 MB per day, slower). By default only the ~65 sports, national and regional channels are queried.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

mando.title: Set-top box remote
mando.description: FutDial can dial the channel on your Movistar Plus+ set-top box through a remote entity (Broadlink, Android TV…). Leave the remote empty to disable it.

data_description.mando: Remote entity that controls the set-top box, e.g. remote.rm_mini_3.
data_description.retardo: Increase it if the box misses digits.

codigos.title: IR code for each digit
codigos.description: Paste each key code exactly as you use it in remote.send_command (with or without 'b64:'). Only the digits of the dials you use are needed.

data_description.tecla_final: Code sent after the number, e.g. OK. Usually not needed.

plantilla.title: Command template
plantilla.description: Each digit is sent as one command: {digito} is replaced by the number.

data_description.plantilla: Examples: "{digito}" for Broadlink learned commands named 0…9, or "KEYCODE_{digito}" for Android TV.
data_description.dispositivo: Device name used when learning the commands in Broadlink (e.g. movistar).

error.codigo_invalido: This does not look like a valid base64 code.

not_loaded.message: FutDial is not set up or is still loading.

no_data.message: The Movistar Plus+ TV guide could not be downloaded yet. Try again in a few minutes.

falta_codigo.message: The IR code for digit {digitos} is missing to dial {dial}. Add it in FutDial → Configure → Remote.

sin_mando.message: No remote is configured. Choose it in FutDial → Configure → Remote.

sin_partido.message: No match found for "{equipo}" on Movistar Plus+.

buscar_partido.name: Find match
buscar_partido.description: Finds the Movistar Plus+ channel and dial for a match. Returns e.g. 'M+ LALIGA - 54'.

partido.name: Match or team
partido.description: One or two teams, or the competition. E.g. 'Atleti Barça', 'Betis'.

actualizar.name: Refresh guide
actualizar.description: Re-downloads the Movistar Plus+ TV guide now.

sintonizar.name: Put match on TV
sintonizar.description: Tunes the set-top box to the channel of a match (or a given dial) using the configured remote.

dial.name: Dial
dial.description: Channel number to dial directly instead of searching a match.

mando.name: Remote
mando.description: Remote entity to use instead of the configured one.
